description: Four independent LFOs in 4HP, each with a rate knob and an output-range switch, and each giving a square and a triangle at the same rate

params.text: Sets the rate of that LFO, from 0.0039Hz fully counter-clockwise to 1024Hz fully clockwise, and 2Hz at the default position
Sets that LFO's output range: U gives 0-10V, B gives -5V to 5V, and m gives the range picked for that LFO on the menu; clicking moves between U and B only

outputs.text: A square from that LFO at a fixed half-and-half width, high for the first half of each cycle and low for the second
A triangle from that LFO, starting at the middle of its range, rising to the top a quarter of the way through the cycle and falling to the bottom three quarters of the way through

notes: an LFO runs only while one of its own two outputs is patched, or while it is the master of a sync pairing, so its green phase light stays dark otherwise
the four LFOs are free-running until you pick a pairing under Sync LFO-mode; a small light beside an LFO shows when that LFO is being synced
menu: LFO-1 Range, LFO-2 Range, LFO-3 Range, LFO-4 Range — sets the output range that LFO uses, and picking one here moves its panel switch to the m position
LFO-1 Invert, LFO-2 Invert, LFO-3 Invert, LFO-4 Invert — flips that LFO's two waveforms within the range, and lights a small red mark beside its output jacks
LFO-1 Rate chaos, LFO-2 Rate chaos, LFO-3 Rate chaos, LFO-4 Rate chaos — picks a new random speed for each cycle of that LFO, up to a tenth or ten times the dialled rate at 100%
Sync LFO-mode — picks which of the four LFOs are reset by which, from seven fixed pairings, and comes up Off
Sync-mode: Hard-sync, Soft-sync — hard sync restarts the synced LFO's cycle, soft sync reverses the direction its phase runs in
Phase/frequency-lights: Disabled, Enabled — turns off the green light that flashes at the start of each LFO cycle
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen; this module comes up with it Off, because its own controls already hold the output inside -12V to 12V
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Auto select process quality — picks the process quality from the dialled-in rate and from which ports are patched, and greys out the manual choice while it is on
